completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the deploy-pending (exit 6) completion loop for the batch /orchestrate engine: the postflight now honestly reports a deploy-pending refusal (verdict=defer, paused commit) instead of falsely claiming completion, cycle_modified_files accumulation across a refusal was characterized and confirmed already-sound, and the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's trigger predicate was widened so any agent-system/extensions/** touch converges automatically on the following cycle -- demonstrated end to end (both via fixture and live on this task's own dispatch_seq-3-to-4 transition) with no manual deploy or reconcile step, and with no new automated deploy-trigger site added.
